message.content: The cover of TEMPO magazine, dated "15-21 DESEMBER 2023", features a central illustration of a large, grey treadmill machine. A glowing, translucent yellow lightbulb with a white dollar sign inside is mounted on top of the machine's control console. To the right, two people, a woman labeled "6" and a man labeled "7", run on the black treadmill belt. The woman holds a white smartphone aloft, while both wear sunglasses and orange shirts. The treadmill's console on the left has various knobs, buttons, and a digital display. Above the machine, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large red letters. Further text includes "Mahkamah Konstitusi Setelah Anwar Usman Pergi H.34", "Lobi Rusia di Balik Pembangkit Nuklir H.108", and the headline "BERTOPANG EKONOMI SENANG-SENANG" next to "OutlOok Ekonomi 2024". A single blue balloon floats near the headline. The background is a gradient of light blue, and the overall style is a clean, digital vector illustration.
